name: Temple Square
description: The main square of the town. People come and go. East is a donation room, south is the marketplace.

name: Donation Room
description: Donations for needy adventurers can be found here.

name: Market Square
description: The center of town, where people come to trade. To the east is the general store, and to the west the smithy.

name: Smithy
description: Heat rolls off a forge banked against the back wall, and the smith looks up from the anvil as you come in. Gear that has seen hard use can be mended here.

name: General Store
description: Shelves of plain, honest goods line the walls, and the shopkeeper behind the counter will buy almost anything, if not for much. Type 'list' to see what's for sale.

name: South Gate
description: The gate to the southern wastes.

name: Outside South Gate
description: Outside the southern gate of Wrathrock.
